name: Melty
source:
A fairy from a a world of electronic picture books. She is  very energetic and lively.
She escapes from a virus-stricken virtual book and appears before the protagonist to ask for his help. Because of the computer virus, she can only say "Mii Mii!!" so she is forced to speak through gestures all the time. She makes the boldly lewd protagonist obey her by using magic.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=28024]Getchu[/url].]
